gloss: highest price; record high; peak value

definitions.gloss: highest price; record high; peak value
definitions.explanation: The highest price or value that something has reached, especially in financial markets. Used for stock prices, currency exchange rates, commodity prices, and other measurable values.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最高値|さいこうね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: The stock price hit a new record high.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最高値|さいこうね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: It recorded the highest price in the past ten years.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{史上|しじょう}→史上：11806_shijou⟧{最高値|さいこうね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}け→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧、⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Gold prices have reached an all-time high, attracting attention among investors.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧ (highest, maximum) and ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price, value). A financial and economic term for peak prices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最高値|さいこうね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to set a new record high
- {最高値|さいこうね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧: to record the highest price
- {最高値|さいこうね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to reach the highest price
- ⟦{史上|しじょう}→史上：11806_shijou⟧{最高値|さいこうね}: all-time high
- {年初来|ねんしょらい}{最高値|さいこうね}: year-to-date high

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最安値|さいやすね}→最安値：13443_saiyasune⟧: lowest price / record low — the opposite
- ⟦{高値|たかね}→高値：14703_takane⟧: high price — a high price, but not necessarily the highest ever
- ⟦{最高額|さいこうがく}→最高額：22056_saikougaku⟧: highest amount — similar but used for amounts of money rather than market prices

USAGE:
Read as さいこう⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ (not さいこうち). The reading ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ is used for market prices, while {値|ち} (as in {最高値|さいこうち}) would mean "highest numerical value" in a more general mathematical sense.
